what: fern-registry child processes counted per view, by putting a counting wrapper on FERN_REGISTRY and running target/debug/fern-run over rows/lane.sql. Measured 2026-08-28.
why_five: run_views.rs reads the runs table once per status: audit-run-registry asks for done, failed and stale and then loops ABANDONABLE_STATUSES (pending, running); summarize-run-storage and inspect-run-artifacts loop LIFECYCLE_STATUSES (pending, running, done, failed, stale). Every one of those five children returns the full row set for its status, so the whole table crosses a pipe five times to produce one report.
